scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.release:check: npm run verify && npm run audit:security --prefix backend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:ci --prefix backend && npm run test:ci --prefix frontend
scripts.production:check: npm run verify && npm run smoke:production --prefix backend
scripts.quality:gate: npm run lint && npm run test:all && npm run build && npm run release:audit && npm run security:audit
scripts.security:audit: npm audit --audit-level=moderate --prefix backend && npm audit --audit-level=moderate --prefix frontend
